items.name: d-amber-deposit
items.refnote: the first image shows how amber deposits look in the game's art direction (take only the amber crystals' look); the others are approved icons of the same family: match their rendering, lighting, background and framing, but not their subject.
items.subject: an AMBER DEPOSIT, the mine every base gathers from: a heap of big glossy, translucent honey-orange amber crystals and nuggets glowing warmly from within, bedded in a low rim of dark earth and pebbles. Warm orange and gold only.

items.name: d-substance-deposit
items.refnote: the first image shows the Substance Well built on such a deposit (take only the raw violet substance's look, not the building); the others are approved icons of the same family: match their rendering, lighting, background and framing, but not their subject.
items.subject: a SUBSTANCE DEPOSIT, raw forest magic welling out of the ground: a crack in dark earth among gnarled old roots, faceted violet-blue crystal shards growing from it and a soft violet glow and light mist rising from the crack. Violet and blue, never green.
